Global Master's Excellence Scholarship 2026

The Excellence Scholarship program provides full financial support for outstanding international students pursuing a Master of Science degree at accredited German universities.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Applicants must hold an accredited Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or related engineering discipline.
  • Minimum cumulative grade point average of 3.0 out of 4.0 or equivalent.
  • Proof of English proficiency: TOEFL iBT 90, IELTS 6.5, or official English medium certificate.
  • Applications are open to candidates from all nationalities worldwide.

Funding & Benefits

Awardees receive a monthly living stipend of €1,200, full tuition fee coverage, health insurance, and an annual travel grant of €1,500.
